title: Caramelised Apple Tart with Almond Crunch
changes_from_base: Pan-caramelised spiced apples under a crisp egg-white and almond topping, in a fully baked case, instead of pears in frangipane.
summary: Spiced, pan-caramelised apples in a crisp case under a light, crunchy almond and egg-white topping.

ingredients.item: plain flour, plus extra for rolling
fine sea salt or table salt
Braeburn or Fuji apples, peeled, cored and cut into 1 cm dice (prepared weight)

steps.title: Pastry case
steps.text: pulse the flour, icing sugar and salt, add the butter and pulse to crumbs, then the yolk and water until it clumps. Wrap and chill 30 min. Roll out, line the tin and chill 20 min.

steps.title: Blind bake
steps.text: heat the oven to 190 °C (170 °C fan). Bake with paper and beans for 20 min, then uncover for 8-10 min, until fully golden. Turn the oven down to 180 °C (160 °C fan).

steps.title: Apples
steps.text: toss the diced apples with the lemon juice and line a tray with paper. Heat the butter in the frying pan over high heat until it foams and turns light brown, then add the apples, demerara, vanilla and spices.

steps.title: Caramelise
steps.text: spread the apples out and leave them for 2 min, then cook over medium-high heat, stirring, for 5-7 min, until golden. Spread on the tray and cool completely. Leaving the apples still at first gives them good colour.

steps.title: Almond crunch
steps.text: whisk the egg whites just until frothy, whisk in the caster sugar and stir in the almonds. Only whisk until foamy; this is not a meringue.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: spread the apples in the case, spoon the almond mix evenly over and bake on a tray for 30 min, until the topping is golden. Cool on the rack.

tips: Cool the apples completely or they will soften the case.
Firm apples keep their shape in the pan.
Flaked almonds work if you cannot find slivered.
safety: Don't taste the raw dough or batter: raw flour and raw egg aren't safe to eat until baked.
storage: Best on the day the topping is crisp. Keep leftovers covered at room temperature overnight.
